summary: Two Covid-era grifters: Napa naturopath Juli Mazi, arrested in 2021 for selling fake homeopathic Covid immunity pellets and forged vaccine cards, and ex-Pfizer scientist Michael Yeadon, who became a leading anti-vaccine misinformation figure.
